prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: Several council members objected that the fee, as written, was ______.

worlds.passage: Last spring, the council of one river town replaced the property tax that paid for trash pickup with a monthly fee charged to each household. Bills began with the next month's pickup and explained the charge line by line, and larger, costlier homes paid more than small ones. But a household that put out a second bin owed ninety dollars for it, ten times its hauling cost, a sum the mayor said was meant to make residents stop producing so much trash. Several council members objected that the fee, as written, was ______.
worlds.explanation: The charge for a second bin was set far above its cost on purpose, to punish and deter extra trash, so the fee was "punitive." "Regressive" fails because costlier homes paid more than small ones. "Retroactive" fails because bills began with the next month's pickup, and "opaque" fails because the bills explained the charge line by line.

regressive.quote: larger, costlier homes paid more than small ones
regressive.why: a fee that rises with home value does not fall hardest on the poor

retroactive.quote: began with the next month's pickup
retroactive.why: the fee applied only going forward

opaque.quote: explained the charge line by line
opaque.why: the calculation was shown to residents
